What is your ideal laptop size?
Thanks to Cometeer for partnering on this video
This video features a Macbook Pro M5 unboxing and compares it to previous generations of Macbooks from Apple. This video features the Macbook Pro 16 M1, Macbook Pro 14 M1, Macbook Pro 16 M3 and of course the new Macbook Pro 14 M5. Which color would you go for Space Black or Silver?
